2. The Settlement Deed dated 14.07.2025 stipulates that a sum of Rs. 20,00,000/- is to be paid by the petitioners to respondent No. 2 today, out of which an amount of Rs. 10,00,000/- is to be placed in the name of the minor child of petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 in CRL.M.C. 2526/2026.

The petitioners have produced a fixed deposit in the name of the minor child; however, they are required to ensure that the same is held under the guardianship of the mother, i.e. respondent No.2,
as the custody of the child remains with her.
3. All the petitioners in both petitions, as well as respondent No. 2, are personally present in Court and are identified by their respective counsel as well as by the Investigating Officer.
They submit that the settlement has been arrived at voluntarily and without any pressure or coercion.
4. In view of the aforesaid, and upon recording their submissions, the personal presence of the petitioners (except petitioner No. 1 in CRL.M.C. 2526/2026) is dispensed with for the present.
5. To enable the petitioners to ensure compliance with the aforesaid condition regarding the fixed deposit, list on 22.04.2026 PRATEEK JALAN, J APRIL 6, 2026/
